name: live_companion_recruit
description: Companions belong to their recruiter, and the follower caps hold (1 humanoid and 1 critter per player, coop-policy/data/policy.json). The host runs the campaign verbs for each slot. The guest's slot (1) recruits Doc Mitchell (humanoid) and a gecko (critter). Then it tries Sunny Smiles (a second humanoid) and a brahmin (a second critter): the caps must refuse both. The host's slot (0) then recruits Sunny: the cap is per player, so this must work. The host's slot gives the guest's Doc a wait command and a dismiss: both must be refused. Both peers must show the owners and follower counts. Headless only: `coop recruit`, `coop command` and `coop dismiss` are campaign bot verbs (crates/coop-headless/src/campaign_bot.rs).
